concerns.text: Tasks T026 and T027 (writing to metrics.csv) are listed BEFORE Task T028 (Schema Definition). T026 explicitly states 'Output: Write to metrics.csv (Schema from T028)'. A consumer task cannot precede its producer (schema definition) in the execution order. T028 must be moved to Phase 3, before T023a-T027.

Tasks T034, T036, and T037b (writing to statistical_results.json) are listed BEFORE Task T037 (Schema Definition). T036 explicitly states 'Output: Append ... to ... (Schema from T037)'. The schema definition (T037) must precede any task that writes to that file to ensure valid data structure.

Task T003 (Configure random seed) is marked [P] (parallel-safe) but the description states 'Sequential: Global seed must be set once'. If T003 runs in parallel with T001 or T002, race conditions on the global seed state may occur. It should be unmarked [P] or placed strictly before other setup tasks.

T001 and T001b are marked [P] but T001b (Verify File Manifest) depends on the files created by T001 (Initialize Project Structure) and T002 (Initialize Python project). T001b cannot run in parallel with T001; it must wait for T001/T002 to complete.
